title: FDG-PET neighbor-matching framework detects nine neurodegenerative phenotypes
summary: StateViewer, a neighbor-matching machine learning framework on FDG-PET, detected nine neurodegenerative phenotypes in a retrospective 3,671-person discovery cohort with sensitivity 0.89 +/- 0.03 and AUROC 0.93 +/- 0.02. The abstract reports external validation in ADNI and a reader study in which readers had 3.3 +/- 1.1 times greater odds of a correct diagnosis with the tool. The discovery cohort is uniform and retrospective, and the reader study is small and focused on one diagnostic pair.
ai_technology: Neighbor-matching machine learning framework (StateViewer) applied to FDG-PET images to detect 9 neurodegenerative phenotypes

evidence.tested: Nested cross-validation in the discovery cohort, external validation in ADNI and a radiologic reader study; retrospective.
evidence.unknown: Prospective workflow impact, performance in non-research clinical populations and the size of the reader-study benefit; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Matches a new FDG-PET scan to patterns of nine neurodegenerative syndromes to support diagnosis.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations from Europe PMC or Crossref. Full text not accessed.
